final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS mix, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avgopt, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(avgopt) AS avg2 FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.mix AS mix, s1.avgopt AS avgopt, s1.cnt AS cnt, s1.avgopt - s2.avg2 AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.avg2 IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.avgopt > s2.avg2) SELECT AVG(avgopt), AVG(cnt), AVG(diff) FROM s3
